item.title: Skyrim's Skeleton Banging A Shield Paired With A 'Raaah' Sound Effect Is An Instant Meme Classic
item.description: Skeleton Banging Shield or Rahhhhh is an exploitable meme format used in video edits and image macros based on an animation of a skeleton from The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim yelling and banging on a shield. The skeleton's animation was uploaded online as early as 2014 and paired with the shouting sound effect as early as October 2025, when YouTuber robparx uploaded the meme. It became the increasing subject of memes in December 2025, leading into January 2026.

item.title: Man Vandalizes J.D. Vance's Home With A Hammer, Becomes Subject Of Memes, Conspiracy Theories
item.description: J.D. Vance's Home Vandalized refers to reports that the Ohio home of Vice President J.D. Vance was vandalized with a hammer by a 26-year-old man named William DeFoor, who was detained on January 5th, 2026. The story went viral that day along with DeFoor's mugshot, resulting in reactions and memes, as well as attempts to learn more about DeFoor and his motivations, with some misinformation about DeFoor spreading.
